description: Signature edition. overview: In the Signature teaching of orienteering basics, What Orienteering Basics Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Map means the detailed orienteering map Attack points means the obvious feature near the control Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Foundations material that follows.
core_concepts: Map: the detailed orienteering map
Attack points: the obvious feature near the control
methods: Navigate method: orient map, thumb your position, pick attack points
history: Orienteering began in 1800s Scandinavia as military training; it became a civilian sport in the 1900s.
key_points: Map: the detailed orienteering map
Attack points: the obvious feature near the control
Key vocabulary: Control — the checkpoint; Leg — the route between controls.
Governing principle: Orient the map before moving.

The working method is Navigate method: orient map, thumb your position, pick attack points Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
